abstract: PURPOSE: To describe the first case of intraocular teratoma associated with eyelid coloboma and the second reported case of intraocular teratoma. DESIGN: Interventional case report. METHODS: A left intraocular tumor was surgically resected from a 2-day-old female with an associated lower eyelid coloboma. RESULTS: Pathologic evaluation revealed a completely intraocular tumor comprising derivatives of all three germ cell layers giving a diagnosis of intraocular teratoma. The eyelid coloboma was repaired, and a scleral-wrapped hydoxyapatite-integrated orbital implant was placed. CONCLUSION: To our knowledge, this is the second reported instance of teratoma originating within the globe and the only reported case of teratoma associated with eyelid coloboma. Although exceedingly rare, intraocular teratoma should be added to the differential diagnosis of congenital intraocular tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的：眼瞼コロボーマを伴う眼内奇形腫の初めての症例と、眼内奇形腫の2例目の報告を行う。方法：生後2日の女児の左眼から、下眼瞼コロボーマを伴う完全に眼内の腫瘍を外科的に切除した。結果：病理検査で3胚葉すべての派生組織からなる奇形腫と診断された。眼瞼コロボーマを修復し、強膜ラップ型ハイドロキシアパタイト一体型眼窩インプラントを留置した。結論：眼内に発生した奇形腫は極めて稀ではあるが、先天性眼内腫瘍の鑑別診断に加えるべきである。
